NL: How many patients are registered in the system?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients;

NL: List all patients born after 1990-01-01.
SQL: SELECT * FROM patients WHERE date_of_birth > '1990-01-01';

NL: Show the names of all female patients.
SQL: SELECT full_name FROM patients WHERE gender = 'female';

NL: What is the MRN of patient with patient_id 105?
SQL: SELECT mrn FROM patients WHERE patient_id = 105;

NL: List all departments and their locations.
SQL: SELECT name, location FROM departments;

NL: Who is the head of the Cardiology department?
SQL: SELECT p.full_name FROM departments d JOIN providers p ON d.head_provider_id = p.provider_id WHERE d.name = 'Cardiology';

NL: List all active providers.
SQL: SELECT * FROM providers WHERE is_active = true;

NL: Show all providers with specialty 'Neurology'.
SQL: SELECT full_name FROM providers WHERE specialty = 'Neurology';

NL: How many providers work in each department?
SQL: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) FROM providers GROUP BY department_id;

NL: List all appointments scheduled for tomorrow.
SQL: SELECT * FROM appointments WHERE scheduled_at::date = CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day';

NL: How many appointments were cancelled last month?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND scheduled_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND scheduled_at < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE);

NL: Show all no-show appointments with the patient's name.
SQL: SELECT p.full_name, a.scheduled_at FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE a.status = 'no_show';

NL: List all encounters of type 'emergency'.
SQL: SELECT * FROM encounters WHERE encounter_type = 'emergency';

NL: How many encounters happened in each department?
SQL: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) FROM encounters GROUP BY department_id;

NL: Show the average length of stay for inpatient encounters.
SQL: SELECT AVG(discharged_at - admitted_at) FROM encounters WHERE encounter_type = 'inpatient';

NL: List all encounters with no linked appointment (walk-ins).
SQL: SELECT * FROM encounters WHERE appointment_id IS NULL;

NL: Show the primary diagnosis for encounter_id 500.
SQL: SELECT icd10_code, description FROM diagnoses WHERE encounter_id = 500 AND is_primary = true;

NL: How many patients have been diagnosed with icd10_code 'E11.9'?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.patient_id) FROM diagnoses d JOIN encounters e ON d.encounter_id = e.encounter_id WHERE d.icd10_code = 'E11.9';

NL: List the top 5 most common diagnoses.
SQL: SELECT icd10_code, COUNT(*) AS total FROM diagnoses GROUP BY icd10_code ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;

NL: Show all procedures performed by provider_id 12.
SQL: SELECT * FROM procedures WHERE performed_by = 12;

NL: How many procedures with cpt_code '99213' were performed this year?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM procedures WHERE cpt_code = '99213' AND performed_at >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE);

NL: List all medications that are controlled substances.
SQL: SELECT name, generic_name FROM medications WHERE is_controlled_substance = true;

NL: Show all prescriptions written during encounter_id 200.
SQL: SELECT * FROM prescriptions WHERE encounter_id = 200;

NL: List the medication name and dosage for each prescription of patient_id 10.
SQL: SELECT m.name, pr.dosage, pr.frequency FROM prescriptions pr JOIN medications m ON pr.medication_id = m.medication_id JOIN encounters e ON pr.encounter_id = e.encounter_id WHERE e.patient_id = 10;

NL: How many prescriptions did each provider write?
SQL: SELECT prescribed_by, COUNT(*) FROM prescriptions GROUP BY prescribed_by;

NL: List all lab orders that are still just ordered (not yet collected or resulted).
SQL: SELECT * FROM lab_orders WHERE status = 'ordered';

NL: Show the lab results for lab_order_id 300.
SQL: SELECT * FROM lab_results WHERE lab_order_id = 300;

NL: List all abnormal lab results with the patient's name.
SQL: SELECT p.full_name, lr.result_value, lr.unit FROM lab_results lr JOIN lab_orders lo ON lr.lab_order_id = lo.lab_order_id JOIN encounters e ON lo.encounter_id = e.encounter_id JOIN patients p ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE lr.is_abnormal = true;

NL: How many abnormal lab results were recorded last week?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_results WHERE is_abnormal = true AND resulted_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days';

NL: Show the vitals recorded during encounter_id 150.
SQL: SELECT * FROM vitals WHERE encounter_id = 150;

NL: List patients with systolic blood pressure above 140.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name FROM vitals v JOIN encounters e ON v.encounter_id = e.encounter_id JOIN patients p ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE v.blood_pressure_systolic > 140;

NL: What is the average heart rate recorded across all encounters?
SQL: SELECT AVG(heart_rate) FROM vitals;

NL: List all allergies for patient_id 25.
SQL: SELECT * FROM allergies WHERE patient_id = 25;

NL: Show patients with a severe allergy reaction.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name, a.allergen, a.reaction FROM allergies a JOIN patients p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE a.severity = 'severe';

NL: How many patients are allergic to penicillin?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM allergies WHERE allergen = 'Penicillin';

NL: List all immunizations given to patient_id 40.
SQL: SELECT * FROM immunizations WHERE patient_id = 40;

NL: Show all patients who received a booster dose (dose_number > 1).
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name FROM immunizations i JOIN patients p ON i.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE i.dose_number > 1;

NL: How many immunizations were administered by each provider?
SQL: SELECT administered_by, COUNT(*) FROM immunizations GROUP BY administered_by;

NL: List all insurance policies for patient_id 55.
SQL: SELECT * FROM insurance_policies WHERE patient_id = 55;

NL: Show all currently valid insurance policies.
SQL: SELECT * FROM insurance_policies WHERE valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= CURRENT_DATE;

NL: How many patients are covered by payer 'BPJS Kesehatan'?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM insurance_policies WHERE payer_name = 'BPJS Kesehatan';

NL: List all claims with status 'rejected'.
SQL: SELECT * FROM claims WHERE status = 'rejected';

NL: Show the total claim amount submitted this year.
SQL: SELECT SUM(claim_amount) FROM claims WHERE submitted_at >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE);

NL: List claims where the approved amount is less than the claim amount.
SQL: SELECT * FROM claims WHERE approved_amount < claim_amount;

NL: How many claims were submitted for each insurance policy?
SQL: SELECT policy_id, COUNT(*) FROM claims GROUP BY policy_id;

NL: Show all billing transactions paid by credit card.
SQL: SELECT * FROM billing_transactions WHERE payment_method = 'card';

NL: What is the total amount paid across all billing transactions this month?
SQL: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM billing_transactions WHERE paid_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE);

NL: List all billing transactions linked to claim_id 900.
SQL: SELECT * FROM billing_transactions WHERE claim_id = 900;

NL: Show the patient name and total amount they've paid out of pocket (no claim linked).
SQL: SELECT p.full_name, SUM(bt.amount) AS total_paid FROM billing_transactions bt JOIN encounters e ON bt.encounter_id = e.encounter_id JOIN patients p ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE bt.claim_id IS NULL GROUP BY p.full_name;

NL: List the top 10 patients by total billed claim amount.
SQL: SELECT p.patient_id, p.full_name, SUM(c.claim_amount) AS total_billed FROM claims c JOIN encounters e ON c.encounter_id = e.encounter_id JOIN patients p ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id GROUP BY p.patient_id, p.full_name ORDER BY total_billed DESC LIMIT 10;

NL: Show all patients who have never had an appointment.
SQL: SELECT * FROM patients p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointments a WHERE a.patient_id = p.patient_id);

NL: List providers who have never prescribed any medication.
SQL: SELECT * FROM providers pr WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prescriptions p WHERE p.prescribed_by = pr.provider_id);

NL: Show patients who have at least one allergy and at least one prescription.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id, p.full_name FROM patients p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM allergies a WHERE a.patient_id = p.patient_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM encounters e JOIN prescriptions pr ON pr.encounter_id = e.encounter_id WHERE e.patient_id = p.patient_id);

NL: Find the department with the highest number of encounters.
SQL: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM encounters GROUP BY department_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;

NL: List departments that have more than 10 active providers.
SQL: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) FROM providers WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY department_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

NL: Show the average claim approval rate per payer.
SQL: SELECT ip.payer_name, AVG(c.approved_amount / NULLIF(c.claim_amount,0)) AS approval_rate FROM claims c JOIN insurance_policies ip ON c.policy_id = ip.policy_id GROUP BY ip.payer_name;

NL: List the 5 most frequently prescribed medications.
SQL: SELECT m.name, COUNT(*) AS total FROM prescriptions p JOIN medications m ON p.medication_id = m.medication_id GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;

NL: Show all encounters diagnosed with more than one condition.
SQL: SELECT encounter_id, COUNT(*) AS diag_count FROM diagnoses GROUP BY encounter_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

NL: List patients along with the number of distinct providers they have seen.
SQL: SELECT p.patient_id, p.full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.provider_id) AS distinct_providers FROM patients p JOIN encounters e ON p.patient_id = e.patient_id GROUP BY p.patient_id, p.full_name;

NL: Show the busiest provider by number of encounters handled.
SQL: SELECT provider_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM encounters GROUP BY provider_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;

NL: List all encounters along with the patient's insurance payer name.
SQL: SELECT e.encounter_id, ip.payer_name FROM encounters e JOIN patients p ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id JOIN insurance_policies ip ON ip.patient_id = p.patient_id;

NL: Show the number of encounters per encounter_type per month this year.
SQL: SELECT encounter_type, date_trunc('month', admitted_at) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM encounters WHERE admitted_at >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY encounter_type, month ORDER BY month;

NL: List patients who have an allergy to a medication they are currently prescribed.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id, p.full_name FROM patients p JOIN allergies a ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id JOIN encounters e ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id JOIN prescriptions pr ON pr.encounter_id = e.encounter_id JOIN medications m ON pr.medication_id = m.medication_id WHERE a.allergen = m.generic_name;

NL: Show the total number of vaccine doses administered per vaccine name.
SQL: SELECT vaccine_name, COUNT(*) AS total_doses FROM immunizations GROUP BY vaccine_name;

NL: List all lab orders that have no recorded result yet.
SQL: SELECT lo.* FROM lab_orders lo LEFT JOIN lab_results lr ON lo.lab_order_id = lr.lab_order_id WHERE lr.lab_result_id IS NULL;

NL: Show the average time between a lab order being placed and its result being recorded.
SQL: SELECT AVG(lr.resulted_at - lo.ordered_at) FROM lab_orders lo JOIN lab_results lr ON lo.lab_order_id = lr.lab_order_id;

NL: List the providers who ordered the most lab tests.
SQL: SELECT ordered_by, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM lab_orders GROUP BY ordered_by ORDER BY total_orders DESC LIMIT 5;

NL: Show all patients aged over 60 who have a diagnosis of hypertension (icd10_code 'I10').
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name FROM patients p JOIN encounters e ON p.patient_id = e.patient_id JOIN diagnoses d ON d.encounter_id = e.encounter_id WHERE d.icd10_code = 'I10' AND date_part('year', age(CURRENT_DATE, p.date_of_birth)) > 60;

NL: List the number of claims filed per month for the current year.
SQL: SELECT date_trunc('month', submitted_at) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM claims WHERE submitted_at >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

NL: Show all patients whose insurance policy has expired.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name FROM patients p JOIN insurance_policies ip ON ip.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE ip.valid_until IS NOT NULL AND ip.valid_until < CURRENT_DATE;

NL: List the total revenue collected per department.
SQL: SELECT d.name, SUM(bt.amount) AS revenue FROM billing_transactions bt JOIN encounters e ON bt.encounter_id = e.encounter_id JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.name;

NL: Show patients who have had more than 3 encounters in the last 6 months.
SQL: SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM encounters WHERE admitted_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY patient_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;

NL: List all appointments that resulted in an actual encounter.
SQL: SELECT a.* FROM appointments a JOIN encounters e ON e.appointment_id = a.appointment_id;

NL: Show all appointments that did not result in an encounter.
SQL: SELECT a.* FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN encounters e ON e.appointment_id = a.appointment_id WHERE e.encounter_id IS NULL;

NL: List the average claim amount by encounter type.
SQL: SELECT e.encounter_type, AVG(c.claim_amount) FROM claims c JOIN encounters e ON c.encounter_id = e.encounter_id GROUP BY e.encounter_type;

NL: Show the number of distinct patients seen by each department.
SQL: SELECT department_id, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM encounters GROUP BY department_id;

NL: List all providers along with their department name.
SQL: SELECT p.full_name, d.name AS department_name FROM providers p JOIN departments d ON p.department_id = d.department_id;

NL: Show the 10 most recently registered patients.
SQL: SELECT * FROM patients ORDER BY registered_at DESC LIMIT 10;

NL: List patients who registered in the last 30 days.
SQL: SELECT * FROM patients WHERE registered_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days';

NL: Show the number of new patients registered per month this year.
SQL: SELECT date_trunc('month', registered_at) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM patients WHERE registered_at >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

NL: List all encounters longer than 5 days.
SQL: SELECT * FROM encounters WHERE discharged_at - admitted_at > INTERVAL '5 days';

NL: Show the diagnosis description and number of encounters for each ICD-10 code.
SQL: SELECT icd10_code, description, COUNT(DISTINCT encounter_id) AS total_encounters FROM diagnoses GROUP BY icd10_code, description;

NL: List encounters that have both a lab order and a prescription.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT e.encounter_id, e.patient_id FROM encounters e WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lab_orders lo WHERE lo.encounter_id = e.encounter_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prescriptions pr WHERE pr.encounter_id = e.encounter_id);

NL: Show the top 3 payers by total claim amount.
SQL: SELECT ip.payer_name, SUM(c.claim_amount) AS total_claimed FROM claims c JOIN insurance_policies ip ON c.policy_id = ip.policy_id GROUP BY ip.payer_name ORDER BY total_claimed DESC LIMIT 3;

NL: List all procedures with their associated diagnosis for the same encounter.
SQL: SELECT pr.cpt_code, pr.description, d.icd10_code, d.description AS diagnosis_description FROM procedures pr JOIN diagnoses d ON pr.encounter_id = d.encounter_id;

NL: Show patients who have a prescription for a controlled substance.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name FROM patients p JOIN encounters e ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id JOIN prescriptions pr ON pr.encounter_id = e.encounter_id JOIN medications m ON pr.medication_id = m.medication_id WHERE m.is_controlled_substance = true;

NL: List the number of allergies recorded per severity level.
SQL: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) FROM allergies GROUP BY severity;

NL: Show all encounters where the discharge date is missing (still admitted).
SQL: SELECT * FROM encounters WHERE discharged_at IS NULL;

NL: List the average number of procedures performed per encounter.
SQL: SELECT AVG(proc_count) FROM (SELECT encounter_id, COUNT(*) AS proc_count FROM procedures GROUP BY encounter_id) t;

NL: Show all providers who have performed more than 50 procedures.
SQL: SELECT performed_by, COUNT(*) AS total FROM procedures GROUP BY performed_by HAVING COUNT(*) > 50;

NL: List patients along with their most recent encounter date.
SQL: SELECT patient_id, MAX(admitted_at) AS last_encounter FROM encounters GROUP BY patient_id;

NL: Show the claim rejection rate per payer.
SQL: SELECT ip.payer_name, SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / COUNT(*) AS rejection_rate FROM claims c JOIN insurance_policies ip ON c.policy_id = ip.policy_id GROUP BY ip.payer_name;

NL: List all medications never prescribed to any patient.
SQL: SELECT m.* FROM medications m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prescriptions p WHERE p.medication_id = m.medication_id);

NL: Show the number of appointments booked per provider per week.
SQL: SELECT provider_id, date_trunc('week', scheduled_at) AS week, COUNT(*) FROM appointments GROUP BY provider_id, week;

NL: List patients who have an insurance policy but no claims filed yet.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name FROM patients p JOIN insurance_policies ip ON ip.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claims c WHERE c.policy_id = ip.policy_id);

NL: Show the number of diagnoses grouped by patient age bucket.
SQL: SELECT width_bucket(date_part('year', age(CURRENT_DATE, p.date_of_birth)), 0, 100, 10) AS age_bucket, COUNT(d.diagnosis_id) FROM patients p JOIN encounters e ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id JOIN diagnoses d ON d.encounter_id = e.encounter_id GROUP BY age_bucket ORDER BY age_bucket;

NL: List the top 5 departments by total claim amount generated.
SQL: SELECT d.name, SUM(c.claim_amount) AS total_claimed FROM claims c JOIN encounters e ON c.encounter_id = e.encounter_id JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY total_claimed DESC LIMIT 5;

NL: Show all patients who have missed 2 or more appointments.
SQL: SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) AS no_show_count FROM appointments WHERE status = 'no_show' GROUP BY patient_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

NL: List the total number of vitals recordings taken per day this week.
SQL: SELECT date_trunc('day', recorded_at) AS day, COUNT(*) FROM vitals WHERE recorded_at >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;

NL: Show the overall claim approval rate across the whole system.
SQL: SELECT SUM(approved_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(claim_amount),0) AS overall_approval_rate FROM claims;
